svg.text: configuration (iii): an AR backbone whose every step samples a continuous latent through a small flow head
MELLE, CuteTTS — Zhang et al. 2026 §3.1–3.3; Meng et al. 2025 §3.2

g.text: the sampled latent is fed back as the next input
no codebook: variation is decided at every step by a tiny flow on a 64-dim vector (a few NFE), not by drawing a token;
two latents per patch → the LM runs at 6.25 steps/s; 49 ms mean first packet on an RTX 4090 (Table 2); guidance distilled away
a flow head at every step
